---
And Tuesday night, every single one of them won!!
Three campaigns that, like ours, rejected the old rules, challenged powerful interests, and put their faith in working people.
And we were in Missouri, too, where I was proud to rally alongside Cori Bush because some fights are worth having simply because the stakes are too high to sit them out. Cori showed up with courage, put everything on the line for the people and values she believes in, and ran a campaign I'm incredibly proud to have stood beside.
---
| [](https://cefuo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001R0NrSQSsH3PU3xZoxpjjNXN33DIM6OSJ-uXeT5evv6-SFywqA7Nzu-LcXtUe3sRNWWY7cU9dgUtLTK7ksNWHufxoyG43R3VCnVSgMhqxvhwhQnH07hs2gUCiDRWrkIQqYPlAPgcWIuJOFTAXxBQR4yikmPnll9GYLV98vKcM4IBOxKpIJvFmJdlQeCtu5_m2zdLSJwVjsMMmikDIMKlXOPTsZSVY5exlnx3NDs9HBrIuH5wZZZPy3w==&c=X_mI2mEQs_iF-H_V9hXDRiFeKCA0-HD4G218DoqDpAklFVZIAK5K3Q==&ch=gR-SPgMJxZFk9q747HtCdTYo0kBU0Od-8KWsnKUQUv5Vv7pR0MXnBA==)
---
But Denver never left the heart of my work. I was here to celebrate our community at the Denver Black Arts Festival and joined our petition team at Del Mar Park to help put a graduated income tax on Colorado's ballot, because we did not fight this hard just to win one election!
We are building the power to make life better for working people everywhere, and no district line, state line, or political machine gets to decide how far this movement can go.

Dear Fellow American, **New Jersey** officials recently revealed that **6,600****non-citizens were registered****to vote** between 2023 and 2024 and **400 aliens voted** in state elections! (I'm sure you agree that ONE is too many). New Jersey's debacle is only the latest proof that **Non-Citizen Voting is _REAL_ and can affect the outcome of our elections. ** Imagine how many non-citizens have voted in other states that have similar **" motor-voter" registration **laws that AUTOMATICALLY register anyone who applies for or renews their driver's license. This raises a fundamental election integrity question that I have decided to ask all Judicial Watch supporters: **Should __proof__ of U.S. citizenship be required to vote in federal elections?** Please click the button below to let me know your answer. | [TAKE OUR PROOF OF CITIZENSHIP BALLOT SURVEY ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84617&L=38431&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcGV0aXRpb25zL3Byb29mLW9mLWNpdGl6ZW5zaGlwLW5kLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3JzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=84571e4a72d59c1ac8c6d47db192d7865f628637a3ad59d9b5913a09c04aee10)
Formally compiling the views of supporters like you will help Judicial Watch raise the priority of this issue nationwide. You see, most Americans are **__shocked__** to learn that voter registration generally relies on applicants to voluntarily reveal they are U.S. citizens. It does not require an applicant to show documentary proof. **That 's right, the integrity of our elections operates on the honor system. We just take their word for it!** That leaves a **GAPING HOLE** in our voter registration system and opens the door for noncitizens to register and vote illegally just like in New Jersey. In fact, it's already happening across the country...
* **Massachusetts** , **Ohio,** and **Virginia** recently removed noncitizens from their voter rolls after finding that many had already voted.

* Since 2021, **Texas** has removed **6,300 noncitizens** from its rolls -- _including**1,900** with voting histories _-- and **Alabama** removed 3,251 non-citizens.

* Topping it off, in 2019, **Pennsylvania** found more than **100,000****non-citizens** were registered to vote.

Critically, these are only the states we KNOW about... **There is every reason to believe more non-citizens and other ineligible residents could be voting illegally in U.S. elections.** Way back in 2005, the U.S. Government found _over 3%_ of respondents for jury duty pulled from registered voter lists were non-citizens... _that 's more than the margin in MANY tight federal elections_ -- and we know there are _far more_ _non-citizens in the USA today_ than there were 21 years ago! **That 's why ****Judicial Watch is holding states accountable by compelling them to follow federal law and clean their voter rolls of ineligible voters (including non-citizens)...** Thanks to the support of patriotic Americans like you, our lawsuits and legal actions have already led to the removal of nearly **7 MILLION** ineligible names from voter rolls across the country. _But our work has only begun_. Our research indicates as many as **17 MILLION** inaccurate or ineligible registrations may still be on voter rolls nationwide. **Your survey answers today will help us demonstrate strong public support to close gaping holes in election security that make it easier for non-citizens to register and vote.** _[Please complete your short, three-question Proof of U.S. Citizenship Member Ballot Survey right now_](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84617&L=38431&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcGV0aXRpb25zL3Byb29mLW9mLWNpdGl6ZW5zaGlwLW5kLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3JzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=84571e4a72d59c1ac8c6d47db192d7865f628637a3ad59d9b5913a09c04aee10). | [COMPLETE MY MEMBER BALLOT SURVEY ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84617&L=38431&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcGV0aXRpb25zL3Byb29mLW9mLWNpdGl6ZW5zaGlwLW5kLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3JzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=84571e4a72d59c1ac8c6d47db192d7865f628637a3ad59d9b5913a09c04aee10)

body:
Peter,

Because of this team, because of your belief, your time, your conversations with neighbors, your donations, your phone calls, your knocks on doors, and your faith in what we're building together, **we won our primary.**

From the bottom of my heart: _thank you_.

This campaign has never been about one person. It's been about people who believe our communities deserve leaders who will show up, listen, and fight for them every single day.

Whether you volunteered, chipped in, talked to your friends and family, or simply believed in this campaign from the very beginning, _you made this victory possible._ I'm incredibly grateful for the trust you've placed in me, and I truly don't take it lightly. But while today is a moment to celebrate, _it's also the beginning of our next challenge._ **The path to the general election starts right now, Peter.**

The campaign we've built is strong, but we'll need every bit of that energy to carry us through November. Today, I hope you'll take a moment to celebrate what we've accomplished together, you've earned it. Then, when you're ready, I hope you'll stay in this fight with me. Together, we'll keep building the campaign we need to win in November and continue fighting for the people of St. Louis. Thank you for believing in me. Thank you for believing in this campaign.

**Now, let's finish what we started.**

With gratitude,

Wesley

name: Sarah  Elfreth
subject: Flipping PA-10 is how we take back the House
disclaimer_text:
Paid for by
Elfreth for Maryland
body:
https://elfrethformaryland.com/ [https://elfrethformaryland.com/]
Friend,

If we are going to take back the House majority and put an end to unchecked chaos in Washington, the path runs directly through our neighbors in Central Pennsylvania.

Right across our state line in PA-10, my friend Janelle Stelson is locked in a tight toss-up race against extreme MAGA incumbent Scott Perry. It is one of the most critical, high-stakes battlegrounds in the entire country, and Team Elfreth isn't going to sit on the sidelines.

That is why we are officially launching Team Elfreth’s Stelson Invasion on Saturday, August 29th at 1:30 PM, and I want you on our team on the ground.

https://www.mobilize.us/elfrethformaryland/event/994701/?referring_vol=7399538&share_context=dashboard-event-details&sharer_role=2 [https://www.mobilize.us/elfrethformaryland/event/994701/?referring_vol=7399538&share_context=dashboard-event-details&sharer_role=2]

We are organizing do-something Democrats to head up to Fairview Township, PA, knock on doors, talk directly to voters, and make sure we flip PA-10 blue.

RSVP TODAY: Join Team Elfreth’s Stelson Invasion in Fairview, PA on Saturday, Aug 29 at 1:30 PM → [https://www.mobilize.us/elfrethformaryland/event/994701/?referring_vol=7399538&share_context=dashboard-event-details&sharer_role=2]

Door-to-door conversations are the single most effective way to swing close elections. Whether you are a seasoned campaign veteran or knocking doors for the very first time, we will make sure you have all the carpool details, turf maps, and training you need before we hit the doors.

Can’t make the trip to Fairview Township in person on August 29th? You can still power the Stelson Invasion.

Chip in $10 or $25 right now to help cover gas, clipboards, and organizer field kits for our volunteer canvassers on the ground → [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/SEMD-03-Email-Aug2026-FR-StelsonInvasion?&recurring=auto&refcode=E31045-20260806-StelsonInvasion-SL-Event&amount=25]

Winning back the House takes showing up, both in our district and where our neighbors need us most. Let’s make this canvass count.

Onward,

Sarah Elfreth
https://elfrethformaryland.com/ [https://elfrethformaryland.com/] https://www.facebook.com/SarahforMD [https://www.facebook.com/SarahforMD] https://www.instagram.com/SarahforMaryland [https://www.instagram.com/SarahforMaryland] https://x.com/SarahforMD [https://x.com/SarahforMD]
Congresswoman Sarah Elfreth broke barriers in 2024, becoming the youngest woman ever elected to Congress from Maryland. She went to Congress with one thing in mind: delivering for Maryland families on the issues that matter most. Whether it's standing up for federal workers, supporting veterans, protecting the Chesapeake Bay, or tackling the affordability crisis head-on, Sarah is on the front lines, fighting for what is right. And Sarah has delivered on her promises. She has spent her first year in the House advocating for the Third District, successfully passing five bills into law, solving over 1,000 constituent cases, and bringing tens of millions in funding back to her community. She learned her work ethic and tenacity from growing up in a union household and honed her skills of problem-solving and collaborating over six years in the Maryland State Senate. Sarah lives in Annapolis with her fiancé, Eric, and their dog, Ollie. | Peter,

Thank you Oakland County!

**It’s the honor of a lifetime to be your Democratic nominee for Congress in the 11th District.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136762292/638503896/680287355?refcode=BLU_EM_MOSS_2026-08-06_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc5OTIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNmJmZjM2M2ItY2Y5MS1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAwZDNhMTFmYTMwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=2G7MiNvzTOkK20K2wtX708kvy2mAUXFaMHw7fuRLMdc=) Thank you to everyone who knocked doors, made phone calls, chipped in, and believed in this campaign. _This victory belongs to all of us._

Seven years ago, I became the first openly gay person ever elected to the Michigan State Senate. And this November, I will become the first openly gay member of Congress in Michigan’s history.

This is bigger than me. It’s about the kind of representation our state deserves, and it’s about stopping Donald Trump cold.

In the State Senate, where I chair the Elections Committee, I helped pass a state Voting Rights Act to protect your right to vote after the Supreme Court gutted the federal one. Now I’m headed to a general election where I’ll take that fight to Washington, to stop Trump’s attempts to federalize our elections and finally pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Act.

This moment calls for bold, fearless leaders, and that’s exactly what I plan to bring to Washington. Michiganders are sick and tired of Democrats who show up to the knife fight with a pie chart. That’s not me.

I’m ready to bring our progressive, Michigan values to Washington. Winning the primary was an important step, but our work isn’t over yet. The general election starts now.

I’m incredibly grateful for everything you've done to get us here. Now, I’m asking you to stay in this fight with me.

[**_Please pitch in any amount today and help us carry this momentum into the general election._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136762293/638503897/680287355?refcode=BLU_EM_MOSS_2026-08-06_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc5OTIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNmJmZjM2M2ItY2Y5MS1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAwZDNhMTFmYTMwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=2G7MiNvzTOkK20K2wtX708kvy2mAUXFaMHw7fuRLMdc=)

Thank you,

Jeremy

It’s the honor of a lifetime to be your Democratic nominee for Congress in the 11th District. = Thank you to everyone who knocked doors, made phone calls, chipped in, and believed in this campaign. This victory belongs to all of us. Seven years ago, I became the first openly gay person ever elected to the Michigan State Senate. And this November, I will become the first openly gay member of Congress in Michigan’s history. This is bigger than me. It’s about the kind of representation our state deserves, and it’s about stopping Donald Trump cold. In the State Senate, where I chair the Elections Committee, I helped pass a state Voting Rights Act to protect your right to vote after the Supreme Court gutted the federal one. Now I’m headed to a general election where I’ll take that fight to Washington, to stop Trump’s attempts to federalize our elections and finally pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Act. This moment calls for bold, fearless leaders, and that’s exactly what I plan to bring to Washington. Michiganders are sick and tired of Democrats who show up to the knife fight with a pie chart. | | | | | | Dear Peter,

Deb Haaland cannot become our next Governor.

Deb Haaland co-sponsored the Green New Deal — a plan that would gut oil and gas production, kill tens of thousands of New Mexico jobs, and hollow out the tax revenue that funds our schools and roads. As a federal official, she pushed policies that choked off leasing and slow-walked permits across the Permian Basin — the same basin that powers southeast New Mexico's economy and this state's budget.

She's not a New Mexico Democrat. She's a national progressive figure, and her campaign account shows it: bankrolled by out-of-state money from donors who will never set foot in Lea or Eddy County and couldn't find Carlsbad on a map.

David Gallegos is the opposite. Fourteenth-generation New Mexican. Rancher. Twenty-six years on the school board making decisions for real families, not press releases. He's spent his career defending this state's land, water, energy jobs, and Second Amendment rights — not lecturing New Mexicans from Washington about how to live.

This race decides whether New Mexico's economy answers to Santa Fe and D.C., or to the people who actually work this land.

We will be outspent. Haaland's national donor network guarantees it. What we won't be is outworked — but only if Republicans across this state step up right now.

$25. $50. $100. Whatever you can give today goes directly into reaching the voters who will decide this election — voters who need to hear the truth about what a Haaland administration would cost them.

New Mexico is not hers to sacrifice for a national progressive agenda. Chip in now and help us flip this seat.

Peter,

The Left doesn't like democracy at all.

They fight desperately to undermine our election processes and, if elections go against them, they use the courts to obstruct the policies We the People voted for.

They persecute their opponents, like when the Biden Injustice Department waged relentless lawfare against Trump and his allies.

And they infiltrate our education system, poisoning the minds of young Americans to hate their country.

Sixty-one years ago today, Texas' very own President Lyndon B. Johnson, signed the Voting Rights Act of 1965 into law.
Last night in Houston, I spoke on the historic importance of the Voting Rights Act and the critical stakes of this election -- watch my remarks here:
Thanks for reading! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.
[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9naW5hZm9ydGV4YXMuc3Vic3RhY2suY29tL2FjY291bnQiLCJwIjoyMTAxMTczNTMsInMiOjc2MTI0MDQsImYiOnRydWUsInUiOjkwNTAxMTkyLCJpYXQiOjE3ODYwNDU4NTEsImV4cCI6MjEwMTYyMTg1MSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTAiLCJzdWIiOiJsaW5rLXJlZGlyZWN0In0.Rd2IOnmZTqjIsPYuH80cmfRdArTqlTJ-gBBgp0PZrgk?)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/3e964a9b-63a4-4069-84db-1bf06978f8bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**Bottomline: this is the most important race in America because it will likely decide who controls Congress for a generation.**
Let me explain:
The Voting Rights Act transformed the promise of the Fifteenth Amendment into meaningful protection for millions of Americans. The Fifteenth Amendment promised that the right of citizens of the United States to vote shall not be denied or abridged by the United States or by any state on account of race, color, or previous condition of servitude.
But for nearly a century, that promise existed only on paper. Poll taxes, literacy tests, intimidation, and violence prevented millions of Black Americans from exercising their right to vote. The Voting Rights Act of 1965 transformed that constitutional promise into meaningful protection by giving the federal government the power to enforce it.
**Simply put, the Voting Rights Act was created to protect and enforce the political power of Black voters.**
Years later, the first African American congresswoman elected in the South, Barbara Jordan (also a Texas native) would work with Latino advocacy organizations to strengthen the law by requiring bilingual ballots and voting materials in predominantly Spanish-speaking communities -- helping increase the political participation of Latino voters across the country.
For decades, the Voting Rights Act stood as one of the strongest protections for American democracy. Today, that promise is no more.
#### **The Supreme Court 's decision in **_**Louisiana v. Callais**_**has gutted the Voting Rights Act and paved the way for gerrymandering on the basis of race.**
Texas, in particular, has become the blueprint for eliminating the political power of minority communities.
As we saw with Texas' latest redistricting effort, undertaken at the behest of Washington, state lawmakers rushed into a special session to redraw congressional maps with one clear objective: increase the number of GOP-held seats.
To achieve that goal, Texas lawmakers intentionally targeted districts with dense minority populations.
This wasn't ordinary redistricting. This was an intentional effort to weaken the political power of the very communities the Voting Rights Act was created to protect.
But Texas lawmakers won't stop there.
After the Supreme Court gutted the Voting Rights Act, politicians in Texas made clear they intend to come back next year and draw even more rigged congressional maps. We will likely lose 5 Democrats in Congress when that happens. _But what happens in Texas doesn 't just stay in Texas._ The outcome of new Texas congressional maps has consequences not just for Texans -- but for the entire country.
Texas currently controls nearly 10 percent of the seats in the U.S. House of Representatives. According to the Brennan Center, Texas is expected to gain _another four to five congressional seats_ after the next Census because we're growing faster than nearly every other state.
#### **That 's 10 Democratic seats off the table in the U.S. Congress. There is likely no path to Democratic control of Congress when that happens.**
**The decisions made in Austin over the next few years won 't just determine who represents Texas. They determine which party controls Congress, who sets the national agenda, and even who occupies the White House for years to come. The path to protecting voting rights and our democracy runs through Texas -- right now, in this governor's race.**
This is exactly why we need new leadership in Texas.
Whether you're a Democrat, Republican, or Independent, we all believe that an election decided before a single vote is cast is fundamentally un-American.
### **The Race for Governor Is Our Last Hope to Protect Democracy**
As Governor, instead of caving to Washington, I would have prioritized what is right for Texans -- and I have the track record to prove it.
I led the quorum break to fight back against the rigged congressional maps at the State Capitol. And in 2021, my colleagues and I stood up to stop Republican lawmakers from allowing judges to overturn election results and from ending Sunday morning voting -- which remains free and protected today because we didn't back down.
**As governor, I will veto any rigged congressional maps that cross my desk.**
In 2026, Texans have the opportunity to protect our democracy by electing a governor who will not only veto rigged maps but also reject voter suppression, and ensure that every Texan has a voice.
This race against Greg Abbott is neck-and-neck. He's the most unpopular he's ever been, and he's afraid of what will happen if the working families of Texas use their power to vote him out. He knows Texans are ready for change.

clean_body: A One Point Gov Race Will Decide Congressional Control for a Generation | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more A One Point Gov Race Will Decide Congressional Control for a Generation Aug 6 | | | | | | | | | | | Sixty-one years ago today, Texas' very own President Lyndon B. Johnson, signed the Voting Rights Act of 1965 into law. Last night in Houston, I spoke on the historic importance of the Voting Rights Act and the critical stakes of this election -- watch my remarks here: Thanks for reading! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work. ? Bottomline: this is the most important race in America because it will likely decide who controls Congress for a generation. Let me explain: The Voting Rights Act transformed the promise of the Fifteenth Amendment into meaningful protection for millions of Americans. The Fifteenth Amendment promised that the right of citizens of the United States to vote shall not be denied or abridged by the United States or by any state on account of race, color, or previous condition of servitude. But for nearly a century, that promise existed only on paper. Poll taxes, literacy tests, intimidation, and violence prevented millions of Black Americans from exercising their right to vote. The Voting Rights Act of 1965 transformed that constitutional promise into meaningful protection by giving the federal government the power to enforce it. Simply put, the Voting Rights Act was created to protect and enforce the political power of Black voters. Years later, the first African American congresswoman elected in the South, Barbara Jordan (also a Texas native) would work with Latino advocacy organizations to strengthen the law by requiring bilingual ballots and voting materials in predominantly Spanish-speaking communities -- helping increase the political participation of Latino voters across the country. For decades, the Voting Rights Act stood as one of the strongest protections for American democracy. Today, that promise is no more. The Supreme Court 's decision in Louisiana v. Callaishas gutted the Voting Rights Act and paved the way for gerrymandering on the basis of race. Texas, in particular, has become the blueprint for eliminating the political power of minority communities. As we saw with Texas' latest redistricting effort, undertaken at the behest of Washington, state lawmakers rushed into a special session to redraw congressional maps with one clear objective: increase the number of GOP-held seats. To achieve that goal, Texas lawmakers intentionally targeted districts with dense minority populations. This wasn't ordinary redistricting. This was an intentional effort to weaken the political power of the very communities the Voting Rights Act was created to protect. But Texas lawmakers won't stop there. After the Supreme Court gutted the Voting Rights Act, politicians in Texas made clear they intend to come back next year and draw even more rigged congressional maps. We will likely lose 5 Democrats in Congress when that happens. But what happens in Texas doesn 't just stay in Texas. The outcome of new Texas congressional maps has consequences not just for Texans -- but for the entire country. Texas currently controls nearly 10 percent of the seats in the U.S. House of Representatives. According to the Brennan Center, Texas is expected to gain another four to five congressional seats after the next Census because we're growing faster than nearly every other state. That 's 10 Democratic seats off the table in the U.S. Congress. There is likely no path to Democratic control of Congress when that happens. The decisions made in Austin over the next few years won 't just determine who represents Texas. They determine which party controls Congress, who sets the national agenda, and even who occupies the White House for years to come. The path to protecting voting rights and our democracy runs through Texas -- right now, in this governor's race. This is exactly why we need new leadership in Texas. Whether you're a Democrat, Republican, or Independent, we all believe that an election decided before a single vote is cast is fundamentally un-American. The Race for Governor Is Our Last Hope to Protect Democracy As Governor, instead of caving to Washington, I would have prioritized what is right for Texans -- and I have the track record to prove it. I led the quorum break to fight back against the rigged congressional maps at the State Capitol. And in 2021, my colleagues and I stood up to stop Republican lawmakers from allowing judges to overturn election results and from ending Sunday morning voting -- which remains free and protected today because we didn't back down. As governor, I will veto any rigged congressional maps that cross my desk. In 2026, Texans have the opportunity to protect our democracy by electing a governor who will not only veto rigged maps but also reject voter suppression, and ensure that every Texan has a voice. For twelve days, the neighborhood surrounding the intersection of Williams Street and Baldwin Street in Madison was ravaged by an "autonomous zone" set up by activists. Over the span of nearly two weeks, the intersection was barricaded by illegally parked cars and homemade "fences" covered in nails and shattered glass, serving as a warning to passersby.

Residents begged Madison authorities to handle the situation, but the city largely ignored the requests. Instead, piles of garbage and dangerous debris piled up in the street, as locals warned one another to wear closed-toed shoes in the area to avoid being wounded. Those close by noted that the "Willy Street" encampment had initially started off as a memorial site, but within the span of two days, became overrun with homeless individuals.

The encampment was set up in response to the death of Corey Ruiz, a 38 year-old homeless man. During an altercation with police, Ruiz resisted arrest and **[injured](https://substack.com/redirect/212f43a3-2214-4026-93a1-06873d7df41b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** an officer with a knife. Police attempted to tase Ruiz, but eventually shot and killed him as the situation escalated. Ruiz had previously been **[convicted](https://substack.com/redirect/82870f23-8636-4852-b95e-e8d31c602985?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** eight times of resisting arrest. Additionally, he had a 20-year long criminal record in which he had been convicted of **[battery](https://substack.com/redirect/3e670812-b199-42d2-acfb-72bf7e0434f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) , [possession of cocaine](https://substack.com/redirect/e51790b6-acd7-43a6-a6fd-b97b64a657f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [strangulation](https://substack.com/redirect/1b268a20-a21a-4838-8ea7-bf3cede21677?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg),** and robbery.

body:
cadem.org [cadem.org]
California Democrats,
This past weekend, CADEM Executive Board members gathered in San Diego to make critical endorsements and continue organizing to win in November. To view the full list of our endorsed candidates and ballot measure positions for the November 2026 General Election, click here. [https://cadem.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/FINAL-2026-General-Election-Endorsements.pdf]
P.S. If you were forwarded this newsletter and want to receive them in your inbox going forward, click here [http://www.cadem.org] and scroll to the bottom of the page to sign up!
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/412F544A32524E6948494C797470636E70587776545562436A58554E6C686E6A2F4D324F54507364445848352F774C43764C4E36447A486C6651583664617A2F/editor_images/OIA%20ICYMI%20Banner.png]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP35/1/80994/images/2026%20EBoard%20phonebank%20high%20res.png]
Last weekend at our Summer Executive Board meeting in San Diego, we hosted a phonebank to call voters in CA-48, one of our key red-to-blue districts. Delegates showed up to make calls for Marni von Wilpert, with special guests like Marni's mom, CADEM Chair Rusty Hicks and Rep. Maxine Waters getting on the phones to talk to voters about what's at stake. Special shoutout to the Organizing Committee and San Diego Dems for partnering with us to make this phonebank happen!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP35/1/80994/images/Screenshot%202026-08-05%20193007.png]
With Election Day less than three months out, we're ramping up our phonebanks to get in touch with voters who will decide this election. We've officially launched our Take Back the House Phonebank for Bilingual Spanish Speakers [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/993604] , and our CA-6 phonebank [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/992738/] to call voters in one of the most competitive races in the country. Calling voters is one of the most effective ways to improve turnout, and you can do it from the comfort of your couch! Join a phonebank [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/887949/] this week and be part of the team fighting forward for a better future.
SAVE THE DATE: The Rural Coalition is hosting a Weekend of Action on August 29 & 30! Put it in your calendar and be on the lookout for more information about where you can sign up soon.
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/412F544A32524E6948494C797470636E70587776545562436A58554E6C686E6A2F4D324F54507364445848352F774C43764C4E36447A486C6651583664617A2F/editor_images/OIA%20Upcoming%20Trainings%20Banner.png]
https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/875048/ [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/875048/]
Our virtual monthly training series equips you with the tools and resources you need to make a difference in your organizing efforts. Our training in August will include a panel discussion on AI and organizing - we hope to see you there!
Register for Monthly Training Series [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/875048/]
https://politicaldata.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_Etr3rKiTQ-GlD4vycoEE-A#/registration [https://politicaldata.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_Etr3rKiTQ-GlD4vycoEE-A#/registration]
Looking to learn more about Political Data Inc. (PDI)? Join the "Basics of PDI" webinar to get trained on account set up, flags and surveys, adding users, processing lists and files and more!
Join Basics of PDI Training [https://politicaldata.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_Etr3rKiTQ-GlD4vycoEE-A#/registration]
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/412F544A32524E6948494C797470636E70587776545562436A58554E6C686E6A2F4D324F54507364445848352F774C43764C4E36447A486C6651583664617A2F/editor_images/OIA%20Take%20Action%20Banner.png]
https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/c/california-fights-forward-stat/event/create/ [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/c/california-fights-forward-stat/event/create/]
We're getting out the vote across California on Saturday, October 10 for CADEM’s statewide Day of Action. Add your local phonebank or canvass to our event directory so we can send volunteers your way and elect Democrats up and down the ballot!
October 10 Statewide Day of Action [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/c/california-fights-forward-stat/event/create/]
https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/993604/ [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/993604/]
Are you bilingual in Spanish and English? Join our weekly Spanish language phonebank as we call voters in our priority congressional districts to take back the House!
Call voters in Spanish [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/993604/]
https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/989880/ [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/989880/]
Calling all young Dems! Join us on Saturdays to talk to young voters across California and be part of the movement shaping the future of our state and our country.
Call young voters [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/989880/]
https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/992738/ [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/992738/]
Join our weekly Wednesday night phone bank to talk with voters in CA-6 and help send Dr. Richard Pan to Congress!
Call voters in CA-6 [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/992738/]
https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/1001646/ [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/1001646/]
Help us take back the House by electing Dr. Richard Pan to Congress to represent CA-6! Join us for a canvass in Sacramento [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/1001646/] or Roseville [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/1001638/] . Victory happens at the door, one conversation at a time.
Knock doors in Sacramento or Roseville [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/1001638/]
https://www.mobilize.us/map/?lat=36.7378&lon=-119.7871&tag_ids=29029&zoom=5&nvep=&hmac=&emci=5c012296-53eb-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid= [https://www.mobilize.us/map/?lat=36.7378&lon=-119.7871&tag_ids=29029&zoom=5&nvep=&hmac=&emci=5c012296-53eb-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=]
Join us to knock on doors and talk to voters in critical congressional districts across California about what's at stake in November.
Knock on doors [https://www.mobilize.us/map/?lat=36.7378&lon=-119.7871&tag_ids=29029&zoom=5&nvep=&hmac=&emci=5c012296-53eb-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=]
https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/887949/ [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/887949/]
Sign up to call voters in our key congressional districts from the comfort of your couch! Bring a friend and be part of the movement shaping the future of our state and nation.
Call voters [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/887949/]
Together, let's make every voter conversation between now and Election Day count. Thank you for being in this fight with us. I'll see you in the field!
- Helen Amelga
CADEM Organizing & Training Director

# This Week with Team Berge
---
| |
Hi Team Berge,
We are officially less than one week away from the August 11 primary!
Every conversation, door knocked, phone call made, event attended, and post shared has helped us reach this point. Now, we have less than a week to make sure voters across the district know who Emily is, what she stands for, and why their vote matters.
This final week is our chance to turn all of the momentum we have built into votes. Whether you have been with us from the beginning or are looking for a way to get involved for the first time, there is still time to make a meaningful difference.

---
| |
# Join us on Election Night!
---
|
---
| |
Come celebrate the work this team has accomplished and watch the results come in with Emily, campaign volunteers, supporters, friends, and neighbors. We hope to see you there!
---
| |
# Get Your Network to Vote!
---
| |
One of the most helpful things you can do before Election Day is remind your friends, family, neighbors, and coworkers to make a plan to vote for Emily.
Please reach out to the people in your network and encourage them to vote on Tuesday, August 11. Voters can find their polling place, view a sample ballot, and get personalized voting information at [**www.myvote.wi.gov**](https://us.list-manage.com/Kp700u69YTa?e=1362dd258a&c2id=d51b517ba2e5c823fe0a3e4f0e8330f1).
Every vote and conversation matters!
---
| |
# Help Us Finish Strong
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
Every community event is an opportunity to listen, connect, and introduce more voters to Emily. Join Team Berge at one of the upcoming events below and help us continue building this campaign from the ground up.
**Wednesday, August 5**(5:00pm-7:00pm) - Viroqua Meet and Greet**Thursday, August 6**(4:00pm-6:00pm) - Texting for Berge Happy Hour (Point Brewery in Stevens Point)**Sunday, August 9**(9:30am-1:00pm) - Potosi Catfish Festival Parade

**Sunday, August 9**(6:00pm-8:00pm) - Text for Emily Party (1929 3rd Street, Eau Claire)
---
| | | | | | | | | | | [Sign Up to Volunteer](https://us.list-manage.com/IMUaClCgPBg?e=1362dd258a&c2id=d51b517ba2e5c823fe0a3e4f0e8330f1)
---
| |
# Help Us Reach Voters
---
| |

The most important thing we can do during this final week is connect directly with voters. We have several canvassing and volunteer opportunities available, and every shift helps us reach more people before Election Day.
You do not need any previous experience to participate. Our team will provide everything you need, and you will be joined by other volunteers who are working toward the same goal. Even an hour of your time can help us knock more doors, make more calls, and remind more voters to make their voices heard. Let’s make these final days count!
**Saturday, August 8**(10:00am-11:00am) - Knock doors in Eau Claire (Launches from 440 Broadway Street)**Saturday, August 8**(10:00am-2:00pm) - Local Leaders Canvass Launch and Rally in La Crosse (Launches from 332 Front Street S.)**Saturday, August 8**(11:00am-1:00pm) - Knock doors in Stevens Point (Launches from 2220 Division Street)**Sunday, August 9**(12:00pm-2:00pm) - Knock doors in Tomah (Launches from 1216 Mark Avenue)
Want to canvass closer to home or help in another way? Complete our [Canvassing Form](https://us.list-manage.com/OX9ftXrc1Pb?e=1362dd258a&c2id=d51b517ba2e5c823fe0a3e4f0e8330f1), and a member of Team Berge will help you find the right opportunity.
---
| [Join a Canvass Launch](https://us.list-manage.com/O5kqG3VBOKX?e=1362dd258a&c2id=d51b517ba2e5c823fe0a3e4f0e8330f1)
---
| |
# Support the Campaign from Anywhere
---
| |

Can’t attend an event this week? There are still several easy ways to help increase Emily’s visibility and reach more voters:
Request a Berge yard sign:[ Yard Sign Request Form](https://us.list-manage.com/VFh4Edkoo46?e=1362dd258a&c2id=d51b517ba2e5c823fe0a3e4f0e8330f1)Submit a written testimonial about why you are supporting Emily:[ Submit a Story](https://us.list-manage.com/_wYcAfkL47b?e=1362dd258a&c2id=d51b517ba2e5c823fe0a3e4f0e8330f1)Boost social media engagement by liking, commenting on, and sharing campaign posts. Follow Berge for Congress on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, and Bluesky.Wear your Berge button around town. Volunteers have shared great stories about conversations started with neighbors, cashiers, servers, and community members just by wearing a button.**Have a question about an event or how to get involved? Just reply to this email and we will help get you connected!**
---
| |
# Thank you for being a part of Team Berge!
---
| |
Thank you for everything you have done to support Emily and this campaign. Your time, energy, encouragement, and belief in what we are building have brought us this far.
This campaign is powered by people who care deeply about their communities and believe that western Wisconsin deserves strong, thoughtful representation. We are so grateful to have you on this team.
Let’s finish strong and make the most of every day we have left. We can do this together!

body:

official: Dr. Abdul El-Sayed is Michigan’s Democratic nominee for U.S.
Senate.

This campaign started with a simple belief: that it shouldn't be this
hard, in the richest country in the world, to see a doctor, or pay your
bills, or believe your kids will have it better than you did.

The pundits tried to write us off, but we didn’t listen. Instead, we built
a 100% people-powered movement, traveled across Michigan, and overcame a
$70 million spending campaign against us.

Now, the real fight begins. This is THE seat that decides control of the
U.S. Senate next year.

# PRESS RELEASE

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
August 6, 2026

**CONTACT**
Todd Cheewing
Todd@Ascent-Strategic.com

**LILY TANG WILLIAMS BLASTS MAGGIE GOODLANDER'S LAST-MINUTE TAXPAYER-FUNDED MAILER AS DESPERATE POLITICAL STUNT**

WEARE, N.H. — Congressional candidate Lily Tang Williams today condemned Congresswoman Maggie Goodlander for rushing a taxpayer-funded franked mailer into New Hampshire mailboxes just hours before the congressional franking blackout took effect, calling it a desperate attempt to salvage her political image after a first term defined by a lack of meaningful accomplishments. To note, the congressional franking blackout exists to prevent incumbents from using taxpayer-funded communications as free campaign advertising in the weeks leading up to an election, helping ensure a fair contest against challengers. The mailer, paid for by taxpayers, also features an image from a solemn area containing the remains of our soldiers in the New Hampshire State Veterans Cemetery—an inclusion Williams called deeply inappropriate and emblematic of Goodlander's willingness to use virtually anything to improve her political standing. "Granite Staters can see exactly what's happening here," said Lily Tang Williams. "Just before the blackout period begins, Maggie Goodlander suddenly sends out a glossy taxpayer-funded mailer that looks remarkably like campaign literature. That's not confidence—it's desperation." "After nearly two years in Congress without a signature legislative achievement to campaign on, Maggie Goodlander is trying to use taxpayer resources to rewrite her record before voters begin paying closer attention," Williams continued. "If she had delivered real results, she wouldn't need a taxpayer-funded public relations campaign at the eleventh hour." Williams also criticized Goodlander's record of avoiding difficult decisions in Congress, pointing to her repeated "present" votes instead of taking clear positions on important issues. "Too often, Maggie Goodlander has chosen to duck accountability rather than cast a clear vote on behalf of the people she represents," Williams said. "Now, instead of defending that record, she's spending taxpayer dollars trying to polish it.”
**About Lily Tang Williams**
Born in China just before Mao’s Cultural Revolution to working-class parents, Lily Tang Williams immigrated to the United States with nothing and built a life as an entrepreneur, educator, and community leader in Weare, NH. A living embodiment of the American Dream, she brings a uniquely powerful perspective to the fight for freedom and limited government.

In 2024, Williams won the Republican nomination and captured 47% of the general election vote against current incumbent Maggie Goodlander — coming closer than any Republican has in more than a decade to flipping NH-02. She is back and running stronger than ever in 2026.
**Paid for by Lily4Congress Committee** ###

Hey folks,
Jon Stewart sat down with John Fetterman, and what followed was one of the most revealing political interviews I've seen in a long time. Stewart kept asking straightforward questions, and Fetterman kept dodging them. By the end, it was painfully clear just how far he's drifted from the values he ran on--and from the people who sent him to Washington.
* **00:01:07** Jon Stewart presses Fetterman on making Israel his political "red line," even when he agrees with fellow Democrats on nearly every other major issue.
* **00:03:34** We unpack the claim that the Democratic Socialists of America are "taking over" the Democratic Party--and why the facts tell a very different story.
* **00:06:01** Stewart challenges Fetterman on his unwillingness to criticize Israel, exposing the difference between supporting Jewish communities and defending every action of the Israeli government.
* **00:08:21** We talk about how Fetterman's priorities have shifted away from the economic struggles facing working families in Pennsylvania.
* **00:10:24** I explain why Democrats need a "Fetterman-proof" Senate majority--and why I no longer believe he can be trusted when the stakes are highest.

This conversation isn't really about one senator. It's about accountability. It's about whether elected officials keep the promises that got them elected or abandon them once they're in power. We also dig into why Democrats can't afford to lose sight of the issues Americans are actually living with every day--from rising costs to economic insecurity--while getting pulled into endless political distractions.

body:
The polls had him up by 20. Now, he's panicking.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/rkar2VMM3hj?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
| | | | | | Peter,
A lot can change in a month.
Around the Fourth of July, public polling showed Josh Shapiro with a commanding lead of more than 20 points. The pundits called the race over. His allies told their donors he was unbeatable.
[**Now, this is a single-digit race.**](https://us.list-manage.com/gqsbMWkYZPR?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
PennLive [**reported this week**](https://us.list-manage.com/aPPX0sUniRB?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd) that we are slicing into Shapiro’s lead.
**The trend is unmistakable: poll after poll shows Shapiro’s support eroding while we continues to climb.**
---
| [HELP US CLOSE THE GAP](https://us.list-manage.com/19YgnlI3P0l?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
---
| | And here’s the part Shapiro really doesn’t want you to know:
We are closing the gap while being outspent by more than $4 million on television in the past month alone. Shapiro is spending millions and still losing ground. Every dollar he pours into TV ads buys him less and less — because Pennsylvanians aren’t buying what he’s selling anymore.
You can even see it in his ad strategy. His own polling must be telling him the same thing ours is: he’s losing ground with working Pennsylvanians.
Why is this happening? Because Pennsylvanians are feeling it where it matters most — in their wallets.
❌ Electric and utility bills keep climbing, with more increases coming this summer

❌ Property taxes continue to rise, forcing families out of homes they spent a lifetime building
❌ Pennsylvania has the 5th highest tax burden in the country — and the economy just dropped to 47th
No amount of TV ads can change that.
**Shapiro can spend $4 million a month on television, but he can’t lower your electric bill from a TV studio.**
---
| [STAND WITH STACY](https://us.list-manage.com/8mUn5eA5sHa?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
---
| | Here’s what we know: the momentum is real, the gap is closing, and the majority of voters still don’t know who I am. That means every new voter we reach is a voter who moves our way. But reaching them takes resources.
Shapiro’s spending millions trying to stop the bleeding. We’re closing the gap on a fraction of his budget.
**Imagine what we could do with just a little more.**
**Will you chip in right now and help us keep the momentum going?**
---
| [CHIP IN NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/j2qeeIf5Ilv?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
---
| | We have less than 100 days to go.
The trend is clear. They counted us out.
They were wrong.
Thank you for standing with us.
---
|
---
| |
_P.S. Shapiro spent $4 million on TV ads last month and still lost ground. We’re closing the gap on a fraction of his budget because our message is breaking through._[_**Can you chip in today and help us finish the job?**_](https://us.list-manage.com/dIlwIFHdYqT?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)

subject: Welcome to Team Dione Sims for US Congress TX-25
body:
[image: image.png]
Hi there,

Thank you for stepping forward, to volunteer for the Dione Sims for US
Congress TX 25 campaign — we’re excited to have you with us. Your interest
means a lot, and our team is already gearing up to plug you into the work
ahead.

Our campaign relies on people-powered organizing, and volunteers like you
help drive the momentum. Opportunities include door-to-door canvassing,
phone banking, high‐traffic voter engagement, hosting house parties,
postcard and letter writing, text outreach, office support at our Arlington
HQ, yard sign distribution, and street‐team visibility efforts.

You’ll start receiving emails soon with upcoming mobilization events,
training sessions, and ways to get involved right away. You can also check
the campaign website regularly for new volunteer opportunities.

We’re grateful you’re here — let’s get to work.

Best, Amy

I’m asking voters to rehire me because the work is not done. As I travel across Virginia, I hear enormous frustration and concern – over the rising cost of living, the Republican-made health care crisis, and the corruption and self-dealing from this White House. But it’s not lost on me, we have to do more than just stand against President Trump. **We’ve got to have a positive vision to bring the country back together:**

It’s time for us to no longer try to simply patch our old health care system. We need universal health care.

We need to be ready for the amount of change brought by artificial intelligence. There will be good things, but we’ve got to ensure we don’t have massive job dislocation coming out of the AI transformation.

We’ve got to stand up for America’s critical role in the world, and we need somebody that can work with folks across the aisle to find common ground and restore our leadership on the world stage.

We’ve got to find ways to bring energy prices down, which means ending Trump’s assault on renewable energy and ending this war-of-choice overseas.

And we need to ban members of Congress from trading stocks – and hold the President to these same standards, too. Because public service should be about getting things done for the American people – not self-dealing.

**The path forward will not be easy, but I’ve never been afraid of a tough fight.**

Getting through the Virginia primary election was the first step, but now that the field is formally set, the next few weeks will be hugely consequential. We’ve got many investments to make in voter outreach, dozens of trips across Virginia to plan, and hundreds more volunteers to recruit.

We’ve got to have a positive vision to bring the country back together: It’s time for us to no longer try to simply patch our old health care system. We need universal health care. We need to be ready for the amount of change brought by artificial intelligence. There will be good things, but we’ve got to ensure we don’t have massive job dislocation coming out of the AI transformation. We’ve got to stand up for America’s critical role in the world, and we need somebody that can work with folks across the aisle to find common ground and restore our leadership on the world stage. We’ve got to find ways to bring energy prices down, which means ending Trump’s assault on renewable energy and ending this war-of-choice overseas. And we need to ban members of Congress from trading stocks – and hold the President to these same standards, too. Because public service should be about getting things done for the American people – not self-dealing. The path forward will not be easy, but I’ve never been afraid of a tough fight. Getting through the Virginia primary election was the first step, but now that the field is formally set, the next few weeks will be hugely consequential. We’ve got many investments to make in voter outreach, dozens of trips across Virginia to plan, and hundreds more volunteers to recruit. = = The fight continues, Mark Warner Before you go: We’re asking people like you – who care deeply about our democracy and the future of our country – to join us in our fight to help Democrats win the midterms and bring accountability and transparency to Washington. =****** | | Friends of Mark Warner 1490-5A Quarterpath Road #213 Williamsburg, VA 23185 United States | Click here to . | Paid for by Friends of Mark Warner

Today, _across every corner of Tennessee,_ our volunteers have stood at polling places, our supporters have spread the word; sending over a million texts, making thousands of calls, and by the time polls close, thousands of voters will have made their voices heard. **What we have built together over the past year,_spanning 150 campaign stops_ across all three Grand Divisions, is nothing short of _extraordinary, and I can't thank you enough._** No matter what happens when the final ballots are tallied tonight, I want you to know how _deeply grateful_ I am. name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: 61 Years of the Voting Rights Act
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/PNG%202023%20TOP%20Newsletter%20Header.png]
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
LAST CALL: Sign the pledge to support a brighter future for working Texans
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Hear%20America.png]
These last few weeks, TOP has teamed up with our friends at the Organizing Revival Network to promote the Willing to Fight Pledge [https://toptx.us/orn] -- a commitment to a vision and future where ALL Texans have the ability to grow and thrive.
We're only a few days from our end-of-June deadline. Can you sign the pledge today to help us reach our completed pledge goal? [https://toptx.us/orn]
It only takes a minute and your feedback provides our groups with a look at what issues matter most to you and your family.
👉🏾 Take the pledge now! [https://toptx.us/orn]
Celebrating our communities and building fellowship this Juneteenth
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/01%202026%20Juneteenth.jpg]
TOP staff and members celebrated Juneteenth alongside community partners at events across Houston, Dallas, and San Antonio this past week. Through that celebration we honor the ancestors we stand on the shoulders of, and recommit to working tirelessly toward a future where race and class are no longer barriers to justice and opportunity in our country.
Juneteenth serves as a renewed call to unite against racial and economic injustice, so that we can chart a path toward a stronger Texas and nation that uplifts and empowers every Black person, regardless of their background or economic status. This is why we organize. This is why we are stronger together.
Taking time this summer to refuel for the second half of 2026
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20summer%202026%20out.jpg]
TOP offices will be closed Saturday, June 27 - Sunday, July 5, as we take time to rest, rejuvenate, and prepare for a busy rest of 2026 filled with organizing and getting out the vote! You can still keep in touch with us online, though. Give us a follow on the following platforms:
Facebook [https://www.facebook.com/texasorganizingproject/]
Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/texasorganizingproject]
BlackTOP Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/blacktoptexas]
TikTok [https://www.tiktok.com/@organizetexas]
X (Twitter) [https://x.com/TXOrgProject]
Bluesky [https://bsky.app/profile/txorgproject.bsky.social]
TOP Tip: Get the most out of your vacation phone pics
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Summer%202026%20vacation%20photo%20tips.jpg]
Taking quality phone pics can be easier said than done! Whether you're traveling abroad, across the state, or just within your community this summer, utilize these easy tips [https://www.techadvisor.com/article/3170604/8-professional-tips-for-better-smartphone-photos.html] on how to get the most out of your smartphone photos this summer to capture those special moments.
https://secure.everyaction.com/_ew4evGgs0i4Ml7-RjD4tQ2 [https://secure.everyaction.com/_ew4evGgs0i4Ml7-RjD4tQ2]
Español
ÚLTIMA OPORTUNIDAD: Firma el compromiso para apoyar un futuro mejor para los trabajadores de Texas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Hear%20America.png]
En las últimas semanas, TOP se ha unido a nuestros amigos de Organizing Revival Network para promover el compromiso "Willing to Fight" [https://toptx.us/orn] (Dispuestos a Luchar): un compromiso con una visión y un futuro en los que TODOS los tejanos tengan la oportunidad de crecer y prosperar.
Estamos a pocos días de nuestra fecha límite de finales de junio. ¿Podrías firmar el compromiso hoy mismo para ayudarnos a alcanzar nuestra meta? [https://toptx.us/orn]
Solo te llevará un minuto, y tu opinión nos permitirá saber qué temas son los más importantes para ti y tu familia.
👉🏾 ¡Firma el compromiso ahora! [https://toptx.us/orn]
Celebrando a nuestras comunidades y fortaleciendo la camaradería en este Juneteenth
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/01%202026%20Juneteenth.jpg]
La semana pasada, el personal y los miembros de TOP celebraron Juneteenth junto a aliados comunitarios en eventos realizados en Houston, Dallas y San Antonio. A través de esta celebración, honramos a los ancestros sobre cuyos hombros nos apoyamos y reafirmamos nuestro compromiso de trabajar incansablemente por un futuro en el que la raza y la clase social ya no sean barreras para la justicia y las oportunidades en nuestro país.
Juneteenth representa un llamado renovado a unirnos contra la injusticia racial y económica, para así trazar el camino hacia un Texas y una nación más fuertes que impulsen y empoderen a cada persona afrodescendiente, independientemente de sus antecedentes o situación económica. Por esto nos organizamos. Por esto somos más fuertes unidos.
Dedicar tiempo este verano a recargar energías para la segunda mitad de 2026
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20Spanish%20summer%202026%20out.jpg]
Las oficinas de TOP permanecerán cerradas desde el sábado 27 de junio hasta el domingo 5 de julio ; aprovecharemos este tiempo para descansar, renovar energías y prepararnos para el resto del año 2026, ¡lleno de actividades de organización y movilización del voto! Sin embargo, pueden seguir en contacto con nosotros a través de internet. Sígannos en las siguientes plataformas:
Facebook [https://www.facebook.com/texasorganizingproject/]
Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/texasorganizingproject]
BlackTOP Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/blacktoptexas]
TikTok [https://www.tiktok.com/@organizetexas]
X (Twitter) [https://x.com/TXOrgProject]
Bluesky [https://bsky.app/profile/txorgproject.bsky.social]
Consejos de TOP: Sácale el máximo partido a las fotos de tus vacaciones tomadas con el móvil
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Summer%202026%20vacation%20photo%20tips.jpg]
¡Tomar fotos de calidad con el teléfono móvil es más fácil de decir que de hacer! Ya sea que viajes al extranjero, a otra parte del estado o simplemente por tu propia comunidad este verano, aprovecha estos sencillos consejos [https://www.techadvisor.com/article/3170604/8-professional-tips-for-better-smartphone-photos.html] para sacar el máximo provecho a las fotos de tu celular y capturar esos momentos especiale s.

Dear Peter,
I want to take a minute to tell you why I’m supporting Dr. Jermaine Johnson to be South Carolina’s first Black governor.
Jermaine is running to build something bigger than himself: a new beginning and a brighter day for every person who’s ever been told to wait their turn, stay in their lane, or keep quiet.
This campaign isn’t about breaking barriers for the sake of it—it’s about breaking them because the future of South Carolina demands it.
Will you split a donation between our campaigns today to help Jermaine make history? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jjrk_split?refcode=20260806]

Jermaine didn’t grow up with privilege or political connections. He grew up in poverty, surrounded by gun violence and homelessness. He lost his brother at just five years old. His family lived in motels, sometimes not knowing where they would sleep next.
But he turned pain into purpose.
Basketball earned him a scholarship to the College of Charleston, where he became team captain before playing professionally overseas. When he returned home, he earned his doctorate and founded a nonprofit that helps working people get the skills they need to build a better life.
And when the political establishment kept making excuses? He took on a 22-year incumbent—and won.
South Carolina deserves a governor who will walk across the aisle, grab folks by the hand, and bring them back to the middle to actually get things done. Jermaine is that governor—a unifier with a powerful story, a record of real results, and deep credibility across communities. He knows change is possible, and South Carolina is ready for it.

body:

Hey Peter,
Prices continue to rise across the country, and I have no idea how much more we can take. We’re being crushed by all these price hikes. I just can’t wrap my head around why someone would support implementing tariffs or starting an unnecessary war, knowing the economic impacts it would have back home.
NC-13 is my home. This is where I grew up, attended school, and was shaped into the person I am today by our community. The folks here are my neighbors, and I want the best for them. I refuse to vote blindly along party lines or defer to party bosses on decisions that directly impact our communities.
Our district is home to many farms that need gas, fertilizer, and equipment to continue operating, all of which have seen prices increase exponentially this year. It’s not just farmers, it’s everyone. It costs more for people at the grocery store, at the gas pumps, and at the doctor's office. There is nowhere we can escape the lack of empathy this Congress has for everyday people.
The current administration and its loyal followers in Congress continue to do as they please, regardless of the consequences. That’s just not right.
I am running for Congress because we need to bring common sense values back to Washington. That means putting people like you first by lowering the cost of living and fighting back against party bosses who assume they can steamroll our democratic process.
I can’t do it alone though. I need grassroots support from people like you, who know how critical it is that we have a voice for the people in Congress. Can you make a donation to my campaign to ensure that we have the resources needed to flip NC-13 blue this November? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/barringeremails?refcode=20260806]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/barringeremails?refcode=20260806]

clean_body: The Next Endorsement I Need Is Yours The Next Endorsement I Need Is Yours | | | | Dear America First Patriot, I'm deeply honored by his confidence, because President Trump knows Minnesota needs a Governor who will fight ALONGSIDE him--not against him. He knows our state has been devastated by failed leadership, rampant fraud, rising crime, and career politicians who talk a lot but never seem to fix anything. President Trump and I believe it's time for something different. I'm not a career politician. I'm a businessman who built one of America's most successful companies right here in Minnesota and created thousands of good-paying jobs. I've spent my life solving problems, not creating them. Meanwhile, Minnesota politicians like Amy Klobuchar and Lisa DeMuth stood by while our state suffered through one of the largest fraud scandals in American history. Families paid the price while the political establishment looked the other way. Enough is enough. As Governor, I'll work alongside President Trump to: End government fraud and corruption. Restore law and order. Work with ICE instead of standing in its way. Put America First values back in the Governor's Office. President Trump has already endorsed me. Today, I'm humbly asking you to do the same. And because we've got limited time to get the word out before the August 11th primary, I also hope you'll make a generous contribution of $15, $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can afford. Your endorsement tells us you're with us. Your contribution helps us win. We're taking on the political establishment, the liberal media, and the same insiders who have failed Minnesota for years. _**by David Shuster**_
The attorney general of Michigan -- the person who runs law enforcement in one of the two or three states that decides who wins the White House -- says she will not walk into her own party's nominating convention this month. Dana Nessel isn't citing a scheduling conflict. She says she doesn't feel safe. "The threats that I receive are almost exclusively anti-Semitic threats," she says. **About Cait**
Cait is a fourth-generation Hudson Valley native from a working-class family. Her mom was a postal worker for 48 years, and her dad worked construction.
As a junior at Pine Bush High School, Cait watched the Twin Towers fall on September 11. The next day, she began her application to West Point.
Cait became the first person in her family to graduate from college, finishing in the top 2% of her West Point class.
She went on to serve 16 years as an active-duty Army officer, deploying overseas six times, including to Iraq and Afghanistan. She became one of the first women in Special Operations leadership and earned three Bronze Stars.
Cait continued serving at home, working on counterterrorism at the National Security Council and helping protect America’s infrastructure and election systems.
Now, she is running for Congress to lower costs, defend our democracy, and deliver for Hudson Valley families Mike Lawler has left behind.
**Why I’m supporting Cait**
I know what it means to leave home for West Point, lead soldiers overseas, and come home determined to keep serving.
Cait has led in combat zones, in the White House Situation Room, and in some of the toughest national security roles in our government.
She understands that leadership is not about earning a title. It is about taking responsibility, putting the mission first, and delivering when failure is not an option.
Cait is exactly the kind of fighter NY-17 needs. With your help, she can, and she will defeat Mike Lawler.
**A must-win race**
The outcome of NY-17 will determine control of the House.
Cait has built real momentum. **A recent poll shows that she leads Lawler 51% to 45%.** But huge Republican super PACs behind Lawler have responded by launching a massive multi-million dollar advertising campaign to hold his seat.
We cannot let Republicans buy their way to control of the House.
**Building the Patriotic Majority**
I started Patriot PAC to elect a new generation of leaders rooted in service, patriotism, and community. Veterans. Teachers. First responders. People who see public office as a responsibility, not a reward.

clean_body: She was rescued. Many are still waiting. You can help find them. | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | Friend,A little girl sat alone in the dark. Lured online by someone pretending to care and taken from her home. Kidnapped and hidden away in a remote cabin, where she was abused, and sold online. And passed from one man to another. Her name is Alice. And this is the part most people never hear. She was found. An investigator in Florida traced her trafficker's username. He saw a connection others missed and contacted the FBI. Agents followed the digital trail, tracing the trafficker's IP address. They moved in, raided the location and rescued her. Alive. Her trafficker now faces 20 years to life in prison. This is what happens when someone goes looking. This is what happens when the right tools are in place. But there are still so many children who have not been found yet. Still waiting. Still trapped. And that is why the Sound of Freedom Foundation exists. Friend, if this is your first time hearing about us, the Sound of Freedom Foundation 's mission is clear: To stop the sale of God 's children. The foundation extends the reach of the Sound of Freedom film, bringing awareness to the reality of child trafficking and taking action to stop it. Our vision is simple: A world where every child is safe and free. We work with partners to prevent exploitation before it begins, support rescue operations, and equip investigators. Our partners walk with survivors as they heal and rebuild their lives. Because rescue is only the beginning. And right now, there is an urgent need. We are launching Operation Search and Rescue, a mission to connect investigators and agents, identify traffickers, and build criminal evidence. We will support real rescue operations using tools like digital tracking and face recognition. This is how children are found and how traffickers are stopped. And today, you can be part of it. clean_body: | | | Peter, Over the past few months, AIPAC and cryptocurrency PACs spent tens of millions of dollars trying to defeat Michigan WFP champions Abdul El-Sayed, Will Lawrence, and Donavan McKinney — and lost. But they’re not giving up yet. After spending 9-1 against Abdul in the primary, now AIPAC is planning to spend tens of millions of additional dollars to defeat him in the general. And that’s only the beginning. Which is why we’re gearing up to protect Abdul, Will, and Donavan from whatever big-money attacks come their way. — Team WFP \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: WFP Election Alerts Date: Wed, Aug 5, 2026 Subject: A clean sweep in Michigan! Peter, The political shockwave is continuing in Michigan and the WFP just swept the state! Abdul El-Sayed, Will Lawrence, and Donavan McKinney have campaigned tirelessly across the state, fighting for the working class and fighting against corporate greed. They have weathered record-shattering levels of spending from billionaires and AIPAC, including constant attacks from both the Democratic and Republican establishments. But just like in Pennsylvania, California, New York, New Jersey, Colorado, and DC, those desperate attacks were not enough to slow us down. And now the Working Families Party is poised to send even MORE incredible fighters to Congress. We want to take a moment to talk in-depth about each of these candidates, but first, Let’s talk a bit about these three campaigns, Peter. No Senate candidate in HISTORY has faced more outside spending in a Democratic primary than Abdul El-Sayed. 1 Yet he has remained laser-focused on the needs of working-class Michiganders all year long. We saw the impact first-hand: as WFP organizers worked with partners around the state, it was clear that Abdul’s campaign was energizing countless young voters and those who had previously lost faith in the political system. Those voters have a new political home. WFP was also one of the earliest endorsers of Will Lawrence’s campaign for Congress, at a time when all the national media refused to even mention his name. Like all of our candidates, Will refuses to take corporate PAC money, and he has harnessed the anger and frustration around AI data centers in his district. His long history fighting for climate justice and housing justice was also critical to his campaign. And as a long time member of the WFP, Will’s campaign has been instrumental in building the Michigan WFP. Donavan McKinney stepped up to run against AND BEAT multi-millionaire Democrat Shri Thanedar in the heart of Detroit. Thanedar has been one of the biggest allies of the crypto industry in Congress, and those same crypto PACs spent millions to protect him.1 They failed. And now, Donavan is continuing the string of WFP upsets of Democratic incumbents, including Brad Lander and Melat Kiros. None of these wins happened by mistake. Voters everywhere are beyond sick and tired of status-quo politics. They don’t want leaders who report to AI and crypto lobbies, or AIPAC. They want leaders who will challenge the political establishment, not carry water for it. Thank you for all you’ve done this election cycle, Peter. In solidarity, Team WFP Sources: 1\. , AP News , July 19, 2026 2\. , Punchbowl News , August 3, 2026 Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. | **Dear Friends:

_Tuesday, August 11th is Primary Election Day._**

I’m hoping you take the time to vote and here’s why it’s important:

We have open primaries in Vermont, which means you can vote in either the Democrat or Republican election.

_**I think having TRULY independent Vermonters vote too, will lead to more mainstream or more middle of the road choices in November.**_

Let me give you a couple of examples of why voting in this primary is important...

_Take the Chittenden County State's Attorney AND Sheriff races. In all reality whoever wins the Democratic Primary will win the general election, because right now, there are NO other candidates running._

_**These races are consequential for public safety issues and unfortunately may be decided by just a handful of primary voters, if you don’t show up to vote. **_

So, regardless of whether you’re a Democrat, Republican, or Independent, you need to VOTE on August 11th.

_**And, if I’m not on the ballot you choose and want to vote for me, you can always write me in.**_

So, to sum it all up:

**No matter what your political views, whether you've voted in every election, or this is your first time, your voice matters more in primaries than you think.**

__Please vote on Tuesday.__

Thanks

_**Governor Phil Scott **_

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2491%2E135344%2EVOI0na)

Folks,
Unless you’ve been living under a rock, you know our Michigan primaries happened on Tuesday night. First and foremost, I want to recognize how much time, energy, and work went into every single race. The candidates, their families, devoted staff, and volunteers left it all on the court.
Now it’s time for us to come together – the countdown to the November election is on.
In Michigan, we have consequential elections up and down the ballot which is [**why I am asking you to support the Michigan Democratic Party as we step into the general election with four statewide races, four battleground House districts, and two state chambers at stake.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-mdp-2026.XH8hqh&refcode=em250806&t=2&akid=2491%2E135344%2EVOI0na)**
When the Senate race was called, I congratulated Abdul El-Sayed on his win. Haley Stevens has served Michigan faithfully, and I give her a ton of credit for running a race true to herself.
But now it’s time to dust ourselves off and gear up for the general election.
Jocelyn Benson is our candidate for Governor at a time when it has never been more important for our state to have thoughtful, proactive leadership to protect us from the whims of the Trump administration.
Garlin Gilchrist is our candidate for Secretary of State and is going to defend the integrity and safety of our elections and fight the influence of money in politics.
Eli Savit is our candidate for Attorney General and will fight for the rights and freedoms of every Michigander and defend our state from federal attacks.
For U.S. House, we have four House seats to watch - Callie Barr in MI-01, Sean McCann in MI-04, Will Lawrence in MI-07, and Christina Hines in MI-10. With just these seats, we can flip the House and put a check on Trump.
[**Join me in supporting the Michigan Democratic Party to win these critical statewide races.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-mdp-2026.XH8hqh&refcode=em250806&t=3&akid=2491%2E135344%2EVOI0na)**
And as if that’s not enough...
In the Michigan State House, Democrats need to pick up just 4 seats to regain the majority and restore our Democratic trifecta. Several of these seats are places where I won in 2024 but we narrowly lost on the State House level. This year we can change that.
In the Michigan State Senate, Democrats hold the majority for the first time in nearly 40 years, and we need to keep it that way in November. There are 8 competitive seats - 5 competitive seats we’re defending and 3 districts that Republicans currently represent where we can flip from red to blue.
The stakes are high, and Michigan is the epicenter of the midterms.
[**Contribute to support the whole ticket today.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-mdp-2026.XH8hqh&refcode=em250806&t=4&akid=2491%2E135344%2EVOI0na)**

clean_body: Folks, Unless you’ve been living under a rock, you know our Michigan primaries happened on Tuesday night. First and foremost, I want to recognize how much time, energy, and work went into every single race. The candidates, their families, devoted staff, and volunteers left it all on the court. Now it’s time for us to come together – the countdown to the November election is on. In Michigan, we have consequential elections up and down the ballot which is When the Senate race was called, I congratulated Abdul El-Sayed on his win. Haley Stevens has served Michigan faithfully, and I give her a ton of credit for running a race true to herself. But now it’s time to dust ourselves off and gear up for the general election. Jocelyn Benson is our candidate for Governor at a time when it has never been more important for our state to have thoughtful, proactive leadership to protect us from the whims of the Trump administration. Garlin Gilchrist is our candidate for Secretary of State and is going to defend the integrity and safety of our elections and fight the influence of money in politics. Eli Savit is our candidate for Attorney General and will fight for the rights and freedoms of every Michigander and defend our state from federal attacks. For U.S. House, we have four House seats to watch - Callie Barr in MI-01, Sean McCann in MI-04, Will Lawrence in MI-07, and Christina Hines in MI-10. With just these seats, we can flip the House and put a check on Trump. And as if that’s not enough... In the Michigan State House, Democrats need to pick up just 4 seats to regain the majority and restore our Democratic trifecta. Several of these seats are places where I won in 2024 but we narrowly lost on the State House level. This year we can change that. In the Michigan State Senate, Democrats hold the majority for the first time in nearly 40 years, and we need to keep it that way in November. There are 8 competitive seats - 5 competitive seats we’re defending and 3 districts that Republicans currently represent where we can flip from red to blue. The stakes are high, and Michigan is the epicenter of the midterms. THEN: Texans started demanding something better. Now, after more than a decade of Greg Abbott's failed leadership, our campaign is within justone point of defeating him.
