That momentum is being driven by thousands of Texans uniting around a simple belief that our state deserves a governor who stands up for them and we’re not for sale. NOW: We're in the final stretch of this race, and we have the opportunity to win. But closing a one-point gap takes resources, and it takes a community coming together. In June, the National Capital Planning Commission voted 9 to 1 to advance Trump's arch
#
Peter, this is Paul Eaton, Major General, U.S. Army, Retired.
In June, the National Capital Planning Commission voted 9 to 1 to advance Trump's arch — 250 feet tall, planned for Memorial Circle, sitting directly in the sightline between the Lincoln Memorial and Arlington National Cemetery.
The commission takes it up again next month. One more vote, and they give the green light.
I've spent enough of my life on the grounds of Arlington to know its gravity. My father, killed in action during the Vietnam War, is buried there. That sightline was designed on purpose — a quiet symbol of a reunited country. Trump wants to put a monument to himself in the middle of it, and he is almost out of hurdles standing between him and breaking ground.
So we're asking for $5.
$5 because the lead up to that next commission meeting is our next opportunity to make some noise about this arch and rally the public against it.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | This Tesla Demo Shocks Everyone "Hi, I'm Jeff Brown...I'm about to get in this Tesla and let it take me a few miles to show you Elon Musk's next Big Project today... clean_body: A child cried out... someone answered She was rescued. Many are still waiting. You can help find them. | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | Friend,A little girl sat alone in the dark. Lured online by someone pretending to care and taken from her home. Kidnapped and hidden away in a remote cabin, where she was abused, and sold online. And passed from one man to another. Her name is Alice. And this is the part most people never hear. She was found. An investigator in Florida traced her trafficker's username. He saw a connection others missed and contacted the FBI. Agents followed the digital trail, tracing the trafficker's IP address. They moved in, raided the location and rescued her. Alive. Her trafficker now faces 20 years to life in prison. This is what happens when someone goes looking. This is what happens when the right tools are in place. But there are still so many children who have not been found yet. Still waiting. Still trapped. And that is why the Sound of Freedom Foundation exists. Friend, if this is your first time hearing about us, the Sound of Freedom Foundation 's mission is clear: To stop the sale of God 's children. The foundation extends the reach of the Sound of Freedom film, bringing awareness to the reality of child trafficking and taking action to stop it. Our vision is simple: A world where every child is safe and free. We work with partners to prevent exploitation before it begins, support rescue operations, and equip investigators. Our partners walk with survivors as they heal and rebuild their lives. Because rescue is only the beginning. And right now, there is an urgent need. We are launching Operation Search and Rescue, a mission to connect investigators and agents, identify traffickers, and build criminal evidence. We will support real rescue operations using tools like digital tracking and face recognition. This is how children are found and how traffickers are stopped. And today, you can be part of it. And right now, your donation will be matched, dollar for dollar.A concerned Child Defense Organization has approved a $10,000 MATCHING GRANT. Every dollar you give will be doubled. $25 Gift Doubles to $50 $50 Gift Doubles to $100 $100 Gift Doubles to $200 $250 Gift Doubles to $500 $500 Gift Doubles to $1,000 Your gift goes twice as far to help find and rescue children. This is God multiplying love. Jesus said, " Whoever welcomes one little child like this in my name welcomes me." (Matthew 18:5) Today you can be that welcome. You can enable the search and help the rescue mission to bring a child home. Please give as generously as you can while your gift is matched. And please pray for Alice, and for the children still waiting. And for the day when every child is safe and free. Because God 's children are not for sale. With gratitude and prayer, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074

name: Jamie Ager
subject: This is a turning point in our campaign
body:
Team, our opponent just dropped out of the race and I’m calling on you for support.

I grew up on our family farm in Fairview, and I have spent my life learning what it means to show up, keep going, and take responsibility when things are hard. After Hurricane Helene, that has felt even more true. Recovery is still underway, and folks across this district cannot afford chaos or indifference.

That is why I am running. I believe Western North Carolina deserves representation grounded in decency, service, and neighborliness, especially when the road ahead is unclear.

And just as plainly, I want to say this. I stand with survivors of sexual abuse and harassment. The allegations against Edwards are serious, and they deserve to be handled with care and integrity. My heart goes out to the young women who took these roles to serve our community.

This campaign has never been about any one person. It’s always been about Western North Carolina and our communities getting the leadership and representation we deserve. That has not changed.

We are building a strong grassroots team to defeat whoever is on the ballot. It’s time to give Western North Carolina the representation we deserve. I’m asking you to stay close in the days ahead. We are going to need people who are paying attention and staying engaged. And if you can, will you please split a donation between me and Nellie Pou so that we can stay ready for whatever comes next? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/np_ja_split?refcode=260806_ja_split_l1]

DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/np_ja_split?refcode=260806_ja_split]

No matter who we face in November, I’m confident we can win this race and deliver what I’ve been talking about since day one: Hurricane Helene recovery, lower costs, and an end to the corruption in Washington. Thank you for standing up for North Carolina with me.

Jamie Ager
Democrat for US Congress

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/80a923ed-6e98-49e5-abc2-73a323b7b22e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Both sides are projecting unity, with El-Sayed participating in post-primary events alongside Stevens, Pete Buttigieg, and other mainstream Democrats.
* **El-Sayed stopped short of completely ruling out eventually supporting Schumer** for leader, telling The Post his position would depend on the available alternatives -- leaving the door slightly open despite his anti-establishment rhetoric.

The website also rejected Christian terms including "Holy Trinity" and "Holy Spirit" while reportedly permitting phrases like "Jesus is evil."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4eedfccb-7dcf-4767-83df-f22885ff2ab6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Our shared movement recently pushed more than 100 Democrats in the House of Representatives to vote to stop sending over $3 billion a year to Israel’s military.

I have good news and bad news. I am going to start with the good, because I think you deserve to hear it. **July was the strongest grassroots fundraising month of this entire campaign.** While Sabato's Crystal Ball was moving 14 races toward Democrats. While James Talarico's billionaire backers were writing $10 million checks. While the national environment was shifting against Republicans at every turn, Texas conservatives showed up in a way that I will never forget. You gave more in July than in any month since this campaign began. Not because a single mega-donor wrote a massive check. Because thousands of grassroots conservatives across this state and this country decided that Texas was worth fighting for. That is the good news. And it is genuinely great news. **Now here is the bad news.** **Fox News just released a new poll showing James Talarico leading me 51% to 48%. This is Fox News. Not a Democratic pollster. Not a liberal outlet._Fox News_. And their poll shows Talarico over 50% for the first time in this race.** Here is what the numbers show. Talarico has 98% of Democrats. He has 68% of independents. And 24% of non-MAGA Republicans are supporting him. That last number is the one that concerns me most. Nearly one in four Republicans who did not back President Trump is currently planning to vote for a Democrat who believes God is nonbinary, calls the American flag a complicated symbol, and wants a welcome mat at the southern border. **_I am not going to sugarcoat this. These numbers are serious._** But here is what I know. The margin of error on the Fox News poll is plus or minus 3 points. This race is not over. Among undecided voters, more lean toward me than toward Talarico. And the grassroots momentum we built in July proves that when conservatives show up, we can compete. The question is whether we can keep that momentum going into August... James Talarico has raised $70 million. He has the national media telling the story he wants told. **What I have is you, and the strongest grassroots month this campaign has ever seen.** Let us make August even stronger. clean_body: I have good news and bad news... I have good news and bad news... | | | | | | | Fellow Patriot, I have good news and bad news. I am going to start with the good, because I think you deserve to hear it. July was the strongest grassroots fundraising month of this entire campaign. While Sabato's Crystal Ball was moving 14 races toward Democrats. While James Talarico's billionaire backers were writing $10 million checks. While the national environment was shifting against Republicans at every turn, Texas conservatives showed up in a way that I will never forget. You gave more in July than in any month since this campaign began. Not because a single mega-donor wrote a massive check. Because thousands of grassroots conservatives across this state and this country decided that Texas was worth fighting for. That is the good news. And it is genuinely great news. Now here is the bad news. Fox News just released a new poll showing James Talarico leading me 51% to 48%. This is Fox News. Not a Democratic pollster. Not a liberal outlet.Fox News. And their poll shows Talarico over 50% for the first time in this race. Here is what the numbers show. Talarico has 98% of Democrats. He has 68% of independents. And 24% of non-MAGA Republicans are supporting him. That last number is the one that concerns me most. Nearly one in four Republicans who did not back President Trump is currently planning to vote for a Democrat who believes God is nonbinary, calls the American flag a complicated symbol, and wants a welcome mat at the southern border. I am not going to sugarcoat this. These numbers are serious. But here is what I know. The margin of error on the Fox News poll is plus or minus 3 points. This race is not over. Among undecided voters, more lean toward me than toward Talarico. And the grassroots momentum we built in July proves that when conservatives show up, we can compete. The question is whether we can keep that momentum going into August... James Talarico has raised $70 million. He has the national media telling the story he wants told. What I have is you, and the strongest grassroots month this campaign has ever seen. Let us make August even stronger. Thank you, Ken Paxton P.S. -- Fox News showed Talarico at 51%. We have no time to coast in August. Please give right now and help us close the gap in August. () | | | Paid for by Ken Paxton for Senate | | PO BOX 3476 MCKINNEY, TX 75070 | | |

Meet Joe Males:

**Joe Males is a Marine Veteran, small business-owner, city council member, and most importantly, a father. Throughout his life, he has put service to his community at the forefront of his life’s mission.

Shortly after turning 18, Joe enlisted in the Marine Corps. He attended boot camp in Camp Pendleton and later served overseas in the Philippines and Guam. He took on leadership roles in his local Elks Lodge and American Legion post, working to ensure veterans in the community had the resources and support they deserved.

Following his time in the Marine Corps, Joe carried his strong work ethic and discipline into the field of computer networking services. He started in an entry-level position, worked his way through multiple leadership roles, and in 1996, he built his own business from the ground up. Joe knows firsthand the hard work and sacrifice of this journey, and he’s determined to make it easier for hardworking Americans to do the same.

Joe’s entry into politics was deeply personal. After his son, a Marine who followed in his footsteps, was tragically murdered back home, Joe vowed that no parent should have to endure such a loss. Determined to take a stand for public safety and the rule of law, he ran for Hemet City Council to help ensure no other family would experience the same tragedy.

He takes pride in his ability to collaborate with fellow council members and get results, even when facing different perspectives. Joe is committed to bringing this same results-driven approach to Washington D.C., to ensure the voices of the American people are heard and their needs are met.

Peter,

After the sudden death of my brother, Lindsey Graham, I was appointed by Governor Henry McMaster to represent South Carolina in the United States Senate.

**President Trump encouraged me to consider running in the Special Election by saying, "Run, Darline, Run!" Now, with the President's _"Complete and Total Endorsement," I'm running to represent South Carolina for a full term in the United States Senate._**

I've spent a lot of time talking and praying with my family. This was not a decision I made lightly. I know it will be difficult, _**but I am ready.**_

I know what Lindsey cared about, and we shared the same conservative values. He cared deeply about the people of South Carolina. With what I learned from Lindsey and my nearly 30 years of helping people of the state find dignity through work, I am ready to take on this next challenge.

It's time for me to step up for South Carolina, just like Lindsey stepped up for me when our parents died. I've learned God often calls on ordinary people to do extraordinary things in the most challenging of times.

I am not Lindsey. I have my own way of doing things. But we were raised with the same values: work hard each day, trust in the Lord, remember your roots, and never forget who you work for.

I did not seek this moment, Peter.

clean_body: | Peter, After the sudden death of my brother, Lindsey Graham, I was appointed by Governor Henry McMaster to represent South Carolina in the United States Senate. President Trump encouraged me to consider running in the Special Election by saying, "Run, Darline, Run!" Now, with the President's "Complete and Total Endorsement," I'm running to represent South Carolina for a full term in the United States Senate. I've spent a lot of time talking and praying with my family. This was not a decision I made lightly. I know it will be difficult, but I am ready. I know what Lindsey cared about, and we shared the same conservative values. He cared deeply about the people of South Carolina. With what I learned from Lindsey and my nearly 30 years of helping people of the state find dignity through work, I am ready to take on this next challenge. It's time for me to step up for South Carolina, just like Lindsey stepped up for me when our parents died. I've learned God often calls on ordinary people to do extraordinary things in the most challenging of times. I am not Lindsey. I have my own way of doing things. But we were raised with the same values: work hard each day, trust in the Lord, remember your roots, and never forget who you work for. I did not seek this moment, Peter. But after many prayers and speaking with my family, I know I am making the right decision to run for this seat. I'll be straight with you - I am behind financially. My opponents are self-funding millionaires or have spent years building up their campaign war chests, but I'm new to politics. We have less than 3 weeks to run against people who have been at this for years. Since you were there for Lindsey, Thank you for everything you did for Lindsey over the years. I know that having people like you in his corner meant everything to him. God bless, Darline Graham P.S. It's been a difficult week. I grew up on our family farm in Fairview, and I have spent my life learning what it means to show up, keep going, and take responsibility when things are hard. I believe Western North Carolina deserves representation grounded in decency, service, and neighborliness, especially when the road ahead is unclear. And just as plainly, I want to say this. I stand with survivors of sexual abuse and harassment. The allegations against Edwards are serious, and they deserve to be handled with care and integrity. My heart goes out to the young women who took these roles to serve our community. This campaign has never been about any one person. It’s always been about Western North Carolina and our communities getting the leadership and representation we deserve. That has not changed. name: Jermaine Johnson
subject: They told me I was too loud, too direct, and too Black
body:
[ ](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260806-2.CqcerM&refcode=em-20260806-2&t=1&akid=1708%2E1086043%2Eu7z3RI)
Peter, my name is Jermaine Johnson, and I’m running to be the next governor of South Carolina.
**I’ll tell you more about myself in just a moment -- [but first, if you believe like I do that it’s time to end one-party rule in South Carolina and bring new voices to the table, will you split a donation between my campaign and Wes Moore right now?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260806-2.CqcerM&refcode=em-20260806-2&t=2&akid=1708%2E1086043%2Eu7z3RI)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260806-2.CqcerM&amount=5&refcode=em-20260806-2&t=21&akid=1708%2E1086043%2Eu7z3RI)**
Peter, I wasn’t born into power -- I fought my way into it.
Basketball gave me my shot: a scholarship to the College of Charleston, where I became team captain, then played professionally both in the states and overseas.
When I came back home and saw my community struggling, I didn’t wait for someone else to fix it. I earned my doctorate, founded a nonprofit to help people get jobs, and ran for State Legislature -- defeating a 22-year incumbent because folks were ready for change.
**[People told me I was too young for the State House-- too loud, too direct, too Black. I proved them wrong then -- and I intend to do it again. I’m ready to take the fight to the Governor’s Mansion, and I’m hoping folks like you will stand with me. Will you split $25 or any amount you can between Wes Moore and my campaign?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260806-2.CqcerM&refcode=em-20260806-2&t=22&akid=1708%2E1086043%2Eu7z3RI)**
As a deacon, husband, father, and gun violence survivor, I believe leadership starts with listening. I’ll work with anyone -- Republican or Democrat -- who’s ready to fix our crumbling roads, strengthen mental healthcare, and put more money in people’s pockets.
South Carolina deserves a governor who will walk across the aisle, grab folks by the hand, and bring them back to the middle so we can actually get things done. That’s who I am, and that’s what I’m ready to do for the people of my state.
**[This campaign is about faith, family, and the future we can build together - a new South Carolina. The fight ahead won’t be easy, but it will be worth it. Join me by splitting a donation between me and Wes Moore now.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260806-2.CqcerM&refcode=em-20260806-2&t=23&akid=1708%2E1086043%2Eu7z3RI)**
Let’s get it done.
Dr. Jermaine Johnson
Democratic nominee for Governor of South Carolina

body:
This isn’t an idle threat from NC Republicans.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1207&source=&t=1&akid=2578%2E124072%2EFCGMKb)
| | | |

Peter, did you see this from The New York Times?
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1207&amount=5&t=8&akid=2578%2E124072%2EFCGMKb)
We’ll explain why this is important in a second, but if you can, [**_please chip in to our campaign by using this link._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1207&amount=5&t=9&akid=2578%2E124072%2EFCGMKb)
**Here’s what they said about North Carolina:**
> “No state in the country experienced as much turnover in election oversight as North Carolina. Last year, each of the state’s 100 board of elections chairs flipped from Democratic to Republican...
>
> At least three new county chairs have connections to a group of right-wing election activists who have at times espoused false conspiracy theories.”
This isn’t an idle threat from NC Republicans: In 2024, the NCGOP spent MONTHS attempting to throw out valid votes in order to overturn the election of Justice Allison Riggs, a Democrat on the NC Supreme Court – the same playbook they used against Roy when he was elected Governor in 2016. And now, they’re ready to do it again, because they know that if they can defeat us in North Carolina, Democrats have virtually no shot at taking back the Senate.
Our team will have a plan. We’ve been looking at every potential outcome for months, but we’ll be honest: We may not have the resources we need to execute that plan. Just like the GOP’s super PACs and megadonors allow them to outspend us on the airwaves, that same money can be used to pay for lawyers that will fight this election in the courts.
**We can’t wait to prepare. We need your help to fight back now.** That means chipping in so that we have the resources we need to talk to voters, get out the vote and make sure our margin of victory is so overwhelming that Republicans have no shot of challenging it.
[**_Please chip in whatever you’re able to make sure we have the resources we need to fight back not just on the airwaves, but everywhere Republicans will take this fight._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1207&amount=5&t=10&akid=2578%2E124072%2EFCGMKb)
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1207&amount=5&t=11&akid=2578%2E124072%2EFCGMKb)

---
Thank you for being on this team.

Cooper for NC

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

_The 6th is a monthly series published on the 6th of every month. Each issue, Harry Dunn -- former U.S. Capitol Police officer and January 6th survivor -- goes deep on one piece of what happened, what followed, and what it means. Full post for paid subscribers._
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
On August 4th, the last January 6th case was dismissed.
The Oath Keepers. Seditious conspiracy. People I testified against in Judge Mehta's courtroom. Two or three different occasions. I walked in there, raised my right hand, and told the truth about what happened to me and my colleagues on January 6th. I did that more than once.
Dismissed.
The Department of Justice sought it. The defendants, obviously, weren't going to object. So the judge really had no choice.
But before he signed off, Judge Mehta wrote:
"Today's epilogue diminishes the gravity of that day, denigrates the work of prosecutors and law enforcement officers who secured these convictions, and excuses criminal acts that caused a centuries-long pillar of our democracy, the peaceful transfer of power, to buckle."
I appreciate strong words on paper. Problem is, that's all we got out of this.

**$30 million.** Let me say that again. **_Thirty million dollars._**
That’s how much AIPAC spent to try to take down Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan’s Democratic primary. And it didn’t work.
Why?
We’ve spent the last three years watching in real-time as Israel carries out genocide, war crimes, ethnic cleansing, land-grabs, and settler-violence while US taxpayers foot the bill.
A real consensus has formed among Americans of all backgrounds: Why are we paying billions to help Israel commit these horrible crimes against humanity when we can’t even afford healthcare, childcare, and education at home?
AIPAC may have deep pockets, but that doesn’t undo what we’ve all seen unfold in Gaza, the West Bank, and Lebanon. $30 million doesn’t undo 80 years of occupation, apartheid, violence, and abuse playing out right in front of our eyes.

When I was growing up, there were two options in my head: Follow in my
dad’s footsteps and become a doctor, or play basketball and maybe even
make it to the NBA.

But Derek, those
plans quickly fizzled out. I was cut from my college basketball team, and
nearly flunked out of organic chemistry... on the same day.

It wasn’t until someone knocked on my dorm room door and asked if I wanted
to run for student government, I began to seriously think about elected
office. And when I won? I saw exactly what dependable, commonsense
leadership could accomplish.

During my year as Student Association president, I was laser-focused on
safety. We added more outdoor lights, blue light security phones, and even
improved our shuttle service at night.

Seeing my work make a real difference in folks’ lives — it was an amazing
feeling, Derek. And
I’ve been doing the same ever since. Working hard to make sure folks can
be safe and feel safe in their communities, putting more money in
families’ pockets, bringing folks together, and protecting your
Constitutional freedoms from those who want to sabotage them.

Look, I know politics gets a bad rap — and a lot of the time, it’s
justified.

But I saw it in college then, and I’m seeing it today as your Governor:
Good things happen when leaders are focused on delivering for others.

I’m damn proud of everything we’ve accomplished together,
Derek. But I’m not naive: The
far-right has piles of cash stashed away to boost a candidate who is
solely focused on appeasing Donald Trump — not the good people of
Pennsylvania. So today, I’m humbly asking: [ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/5667?t=1002&akid=169%2E245147%2EJQPKXk ]Will you chip in a donation
of any amount to help us stay on track for victory here in Pennsylvania? I

like you get off the sidelines and into the game.

Hormuz Deal Within Reach
President Trump signaled that a breakthrough with Iran over the Strait of Hormuz is close, telling reporters the talks are moving along nicely while touting a [massive munitions](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckD2unTAQRlcDnZExtnEKF2lu99KmRAMeuKPnH-QxkOw-epGygfSfvqNzfn4sH0CR8vEDEnpiXkIJC9SEIUGGWpEbBmitXuk8yqKkskI6Ie0CW6MbFw198EaNbnc9-nF2VlppR9e__bdZqRE32Hct13lDZ7SZnNbamnlc56kn__UnnbRqMtbMAxoJarUqSAsmTHun5XUGaDhQZgrIWynnWSI12ngo9eijf7d2cjd979SrU6_neYa9_Mr48LCV1KnXv3mnXn8tBMNvFheLBMx0o0hXpkYls-BWts-TIoq7PCxaReCSy8UiInxiZbEi5UO8r9wwiFCe3FcfzodiJLZzp-WRgOIXuW__m_P26k8AAAD__779izs) stockpile and vowing leakers would be hunted down. Washington now appears ready to [embrace an](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckD2O2zAQRk9DdRTosUhrCxVp1G3alMIsZyQNwD-Q9CrO6QPnCDnA9-G99-tz-0QJko6fGHmR1jbKtGGNTBET1sqtM2Hv9RnLkTcw4LSZtXEb-i7fvE040GLhNu_zwMvtMTvjjLvNw7lYNhbAst_xazeEk3dA8DF72u3H7GGQ5f1nZuPgbp19jGwNwpcDMg4t3Xc1mWch7DxKakLcfM6l5CBdfBtzPYawnL2Xpu4_FKwK1uu6xgvbKenoOfFvjJK4jj5HBSuhhJfOSRPvnBorWCf3sJNxCtZ_ihpLYaxNV0Z6afSeS9dSMekc8T3EoFuvKF3nXZ-5xucfjU2f0nS-koJ1qAuVS0KQ5h5qMkdECW-Aof9v4O8F_gYAAP__XzCPrg) Iran-Oman arrangement reopening the vital chokepoint for service fees, sparing what Trump called the largest planned strike since World War II. Yet Tehran publicly denies negotiating directly with the United States, and the president has offered Iran one [last chance](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckLFugzAQhp8GNiPnAsYZPHRhS9eO6OAOcpKxLdsJffwqlfoC3X_9n77v6z7fUbyE_RMPdlLKTJFmzAfTgQFz5lKZsNb8PNIeZ9BglLZKmxnXKi-ee2zJDXCxm23ZXUZrtNHmYtuHs7DAYka69bAZht4i4qLpNmhjexr7Vtz7T1tt4DqYYex40AiLAdIGB7puTa-fibByJ6EIcVljTCl6qbKWLua99e5RayrN9aOBqYHpPM9ui9-Bz9Kt8Whg-ps3MP1aqLhtnIuSjEF5LFWtDwwrK2L0KnNirEwq4bNwURuKVxxInZjb7Cid4r0UMza93g8U_6a09b_pXg5-AgAA___CMoKb) before escalation resumes. War Secretary Pete Hegseth stressed that U.S. forces remain on full alert and ready to act if diplomacy fails, while Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent suggested an agreement could land within days. Oil prices eased on the diplomatic optimism, though analysts caution that repeated broken ceasefires have left markets wary of another sudden reversal. ★★★
Court Clears Haiti Removals
A federal judge acknowledged that the order shielding hundreds of thousands of Haitians from deportation is no longer in effect, following the Supreme Court decision that [cleared the path](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0LGOpDAQBNCvgczIGGiYwMElZHPphajH3YBvbWzZZtjPX7HS_sBmFZSqpPfvuTzROntsf9GztjkvFGjB5Jk8HpgS58KEpaTTxy0sSioQchISFjTFvnnpsSY9qHZap5p1O04gQUI71bsGxlG-RuqNganjFkbZPagb4LG2D1BdbfW9JycJqhtgGBseJKoXKJKAA3Vr1cszEhZu7JEtcTYhxBicLdbkJqStdnovJeaq-1OpuVLzdV3NGj4PvnJjgq_U_FOv1LwycUIn_p-0sUDzcYTLMW2cRT5jYs_ChDMVkc7bRBjHmO4Qsezi20DwQWJHW6woMddJU7ysczbDWPVy82jd_VuX32K-tfoKAAD__0_OicU) to end Temporary Protected Status. The ruling caps a yearslong fight over the Biden-era TPS expansion and hands Trump a signature immigration victory he campaigned on relentlessly. Enforcement is already underway, with ICE fitting Haitian recipients with [ankle monitors](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckDuO3DAQBU9DZRSoFkXJAQMnytapQ6GH7NE0VvyA7F3ZtzfmCk4f8KqA-v1xfCBfnM9fmMhz70cs8cCWKCbM2Bp1oYgi7SvVsxxgwGmzaeMODMLfdFgcol9g2p7bQH5aN2eccdM2vHx0tM6LfRhr7OQmIFrmGSA-n4_4wIkG9m-e2YyDeXHLOtJiEB4OonG4xPmprPmqEYVGzp0j9VBKreVi4dDH0s7h8i-R2tX8U8GuYL_ve7yxvzifUjL9wcSZ2hhKUrC_n-Gvgp1T4rOhcMkKdutW637Aew-kpWH45HzqF7IwZi2160aBK1OWrjF_XqRTySyldQX70HysN18Xd7cqa86EfL2Ng_xv0W8P_wIAAP__sduKPw) as removal operations ramp up in communities including Springfield, Ohio. Homeland Security officials insist the status was never intended as permanent amnesty and have vowed swift, orderly action across affected states in the weeks ahead. The issue was a centerpiece of the 2024 campaign, when Trump and Vance spotlighted Springfield as a symbol of the strain the expanded program placed on small American towns. ★★★
Armed Man Arrested
A California man was arrested at Trump National Golf Club in Rancho Palos Verdes after federal agents spotted him photographing [security preparations](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0EGupCAQxvHT6A5TgqK9YDEbdz3bWZpqKJUEgVDYztx-0i95F3gX-P75fX-e6xN98HH_jScZz7y65FYsJ7kTI5ZCXMlhreU6855WCVILmAXoFW31b1oHbJ0ZZT9vc0umn2YNGnQ_t4eZepQTgLZWAQ1WvR7Dg9xLqXmCByhovfnswQxaqlGPU0cjoHxp6UDj6NTWDHBlh5U6H9k7YptSzin46i13qextMEetmRv1q5FLI5f7vrst_Y10c2fT2cjl4kYuJ0bxrRFfGLGnsAmbrsIk8CB0Ihf6RGJl8fbsq8AQaCcX_okDnbgJc4osLNqD2mJcvn0InvXUDLCf6MOn2Naf3vg28n8AAAD__7BGhwY) days before the president's scheduled visit. Jeanine John Taele, 38, was carrying a loaded magazine and had additional weapons, body armor, and a fake security badge, according to the [FBI and](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckLGupiAQRp8GuzGIgjQU29jdbbc0c2HUuUEwgP_mf_uNN9kXuM2Uc75z_nysH8iR0_4bT3Jc6xpyWLGcFE5MWArVRgFbK_d57XlVUhmQFqRZ0Td-0TphF5xWg91sR26YrZFGmsF2h_N61GiVHO3kR2umGdHYYQsBB7R6Gjt2zz9ppVGjNnruSUtUn0YFaVCHcROTvK-AjXpOlQNVn_N15ciNfe1z2bvojtauKsZfQi1CLQE5vj3GSKX3-RRqeRBCLdI-ZxJq2T4Z_pvBF2HiRPCVjwQNKRLkuz0sCDlhDPCtDnuOG_h8l0oQcwVMO0WqcBC-OL7hOxlU8nfh9oZ2FMIm1NIVF66_HCNXM4tJ7idyfJZ17ae5X079CwAA__83kZNP) sheriff's deputies. He pleaded not guilty to four charges, with bail set at $250,000 after officials revealed he was already [out on](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckL2unTAQhJ_GdEZmDzacwkUaups2JVrshbOSf5BtLnn8iEh5gXTTzIy-79fX-oUcOB0_MZLlWlef_Yolko-YsBSqjTy2Vq54HnkFBUaqWSqzomv8TeuInbcahnmfO7LDNBtllBnm7mM38sYPBudN72TQATzBvV9vg4NXrmP77KlZGXhpo6eetELYDHhlUPvXLkZ1nR4b9Zwqe6ou5_PMgRu72udydMF-WjureP0QsAhY7vvub6wfTkfLiX5j5ESldzkKWBLdVcDiCkcSsIxm0hreApbjShGT_Mcr_-LKI4ddunyVSnJDDvIsnIt0WJ92V6w_bw6Bq5nEqI6IHJ6jrv2vyG8LfwIAAP__eMaHFQ) bail in a separate case.
